content: contains news articles and associated highlights, i.e., a few bullet points giving a brief overview of the article. We used the standard splits of BIBREF24 for training, validation, and testing (90,266/1,220/1,093 CNN documents and 196,961/12,148/10,397 DailyMail documents). We did not anonymize entities. We first split sentences with the Stanford CoreNLP toolkit BIBREF26 and pre-processed the dataset following BIBREF6. Input documents were truncated to 512 tokens.
